changes.subject: feat(search): search inside note attachments (#41)
changes.body: PDF and image text is now indexed. Search returns in about 0.4 s on 10000 notes, was 2.5 s.
changes.heading: When you search
changes.note: Search now looks inside attached PDFs and images, and answers in about 0.4 s on 10000 notes instead of 2.5 s.

changes.subject: fix(export): keep line breaks when exporting to Markdown (#43)
changes.heading: When you share or export
changes.note: Markdown exports keep your line breaks.

changes.subject: feat!: pinned notes; sync server must be 2.0 or newer (#44)
changes.body: BREAKING: self-hosted sync servers older than 2.0 reject the new pinned field. Upgrade the server first.
changes.heading: When you organise notes
changes.note: If you run your own sync server, upgrade it to 2.0 or newer before updating the app. Then pin notes to keep them at the top.

changes.subject: refactor: split NoteStore into reader and writer (#45)
feat(settings): follow the system dark mode (#47)
changes.heading: Settings
changes.note: The app can follow your system dark mode.
